claim_text: Car-sized balls of light travelling at great speed out of a mother ship, going into Canada and up and down the east coast, with the largest ship over the Vatican, presented as a great deception rather than aliens.
quote: the major ship that I saw was over the Vatican
falsify_match: A mass sighting event centred on the Vatican with smaller objects over Canada and the American east coast.
falsify_miss: No such event. Drone and light sightings over the eastern seaboard were already a running news story in late 2024, which is the material this reads onto.

claim_text: The ships were seen over temples in Mexico rather than over America, places he says they had been before, and fearful sights are coming that will bring people to their knees.
quote: these temples down in Mexico. It's like they'd been there before
falsify_match: A widely witnessed aerial event over Mesoamerican temple sites.
falsify_miss: No such event. He offers the choice of Mexico over America as evidence the vision was not his own construction.

claim_text: Beef shortages follow what was done to the chickens and eggs, and crickets are ground into burgers and patties as an alternative protein, which he calls planned population control rather than anything wrong with the cattle.
quote: There's nothing wrong with your cows
falsify_match: A beef supply disruption followed by insect protein promoted as the replacement.
falsify_miss: Beef supply holds. Insect protein products already existed and were being promoted in Europe and Asia before this, which he acknowledges when viewers tell him they already eat them.

claim_text: A cast iron skillet with coconut oil heating up, the first kernels about to pop, given as the picture of the greatest demonstrations of glory beginning in places least expected, worldwide rather than only American.
quote: the first major kernels are about to pop
falsify_match: Unconnected revival outbreaks starting in several unexpected places.
falsify_miss: No outbreak. This is the earliest telling of the popcorn image on file, four weeks before the Tulsa and Branson version.

claim_text: People are seen with their noses to the ground, too busy paying bills to look at the horizon, sitting in a kettle whose water level and temperature are both rising without their noticing.
quote: they didn't realize they were in a pot that was starting to boil
falsify_match: Not checkable as an event; it is a verdict on public attention.
falsify_miss: No observation could refute it, since inattention is the thing being described. Recorded as unfalsifiable in form.

claim_text: The plague seen again starting in Europe, with black rats with red eyes running through old French towns and making people sick, and an instruction repeated three times that prayer will lessen it.
quote: I saw a plague and I saw it starting in Europe again
falsify_match: A rodent-borne epidemic beginning in western Europe.
falsify_miss: No such epidemic. The prayer-lessens-it condition means a smaller outbreak, or none, can both be read as answered prayer.

claim_text: The plague spreads from Europe to Africa and then the Middle East, with each nation's face shown bolded in black and red and then fading away as it passes through.
quote: as the the virus spread it they started to fade away
falsify_match: A pandemic moving in that sequence with heavy mortality on each continent.
falsify_miss: No pandemic follows that path. The fading faces are his image for mortality rather than a stated figure.

claim_text: Australia is one of the last places the plague reaches because of where it is, and he states that COVID was a test drive for this one.
quote: For CO was a test drive
falsify_match: A pandemic notably worse than COVID reaching Australia late.
falsify_miss: No such pandemic. Australia was in fact reached late by COVID because of its border closure, so the geographic reasoning describes what already happened.

claim_text: He is told there are three other major rats around the president who must be identified, and that even those against Trump will be grateful for strong leadership because of what is coming.
quote: there's three other major rats, three rats
falsify_match: Three senior figures in the administration exposed as leaking or disloyal.
falsify_miss: No such exposure, or a different number. The number three is the only checkable part, since he names nobody.

claim_text: Lions carved into the side of a building he later learns is the New York Stock Exchange, with Wall Street completely closed down when the major event happens, and Chinook helicopters flying aid in from the west coast so low the houses vibrate.
quote: Wall Street was completely closed down whenever this major event happens
falsify_match: An extended closure of the New York Stock Exchange with military aid flights across the country.
falsify_miss: No such closure. The exchange has closed for more than a day only a handful of times, most recently after 9/11 and Hurricane Sandy.

claim_text: The Mississippi flowing out a different place after the shaking, with fires and devastation, and the army building a makeshift bridge out of flat pontoon boats so trucks can cross.
quote: I saw the Mississippi River flowing differently
falsify_match: A New Madrid earthquake large enough to alter the river's course and destroy the bridges.
falsify_miss: No such earthquake. The 1811-12 sequence did briefly reverse the river, so the detail is drawn from a known historical event.

claim_text: He is told the president will be used to accelerate end time events, with a great acceleration in the Middle East, and that the talk of peace and safety precedes the sudden destruction he has already seen.
quote: I will use President Trump to accelerate the end time events
falsify_match: A sudden reversal following a publicised Middle East peace agreement.
falsify_miss: A peace framework holds. The peace-then-destruction shape means an agreement is required first, which makes any settlement a confirmation rather than a refutation.

claim_text: A major nuclear submarine surfacing at Cuba which he is told is Russian, with the size pointed out to him, alongside warnings about cyber attacks on old infrastructure.
quote: a major nuclear sub surfacing in um Cuba
falsify_match: A Russian nuclear submarine surfacing at a Cuban port.
falsify_miss: No such visit. The Kazan, a nuclear-powered Russian submarine, called at Havana in June 2024 and was widely reported a year before this.

claim_text: A new industrial revolution from AI and quantum computing that makes crypto already ancient, bringing cures for diseases and scientific breakthroughs, alongside Neuralink chips letting quadriplegics control games with their minds.
quote: crypto is already behind
falsify_match: AI-derived cures for major diseases arriving in a few years.
falsify_miss: No such arrival. The Neuralink demonstrations he cites had already been published, so that part is reported rather than foreseen.

claim_text: Weather warfare with record snowfall where it has never fallen like that, record rainfall in China so bad a raft is needed, and drought so severe that nothing grows a couple of miles from where it is flooding.
quote: Weather warfare is what the Lord said
falsify_match: Evidence of deliberate weather modification producing these extremes.
falsify_miss: Extremes occur without any manipulation being shown. The record Chinese rainfall he cites was current news at the time of speaking.

claim_text: Teaching that the hard times coming are a refining fire rather than Ichabod, and that people will wrongly conclude God has departed when the shakings arrive.
quote: This is not anabad. This is not kabad
falsify_match: Not applicable; doctrinal framing.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though it pre-empts the reading that unanswered warnings mean the words were not from God.

claim_text: No politician and no congressional majority will save America, only repentance, recalling the great earthquakes seen in British Columbia and across California and the volcanoes and dying fish.
quote: There's no politician that's ever going to save America
falsify_match: Not applicable; an appeal rather than a claim.
falsify_miss: Not applicable. The earthquakes are recalled here rather than newly given.

claim_text: A major harvest of souls in Asia and in the underground churches of China and Iran, with a Chinese viewer reporting conversion through the AI-translated channel and many in South Korea led to Christ that week.
quote: there will be a major outpouring of my spirit in Iran
falsify_match: Documented mass conversion in Iran or the Chinese underground church.
falsify_miss: No measurable change. Iranian house church growth has been reported by monitoring groups since the 2000s, so the direction predates the word.

claim_text: Iranian women with coverings on their heads seen with the glory on them, repenting and coming to Christ by the tens of thousands, and he says revival is already under way in parts of Africa and the Middle East.
quote: they're coming to Jesus by the tens of thousands
falsify_match: Conversions in the tens of thousands in Iran within a definable period.
falsify_miss: No such figure can be established. He says himself he is ignorant of the culture and does not know what the head covering is.

claim_text: Channel growth reported: seven other language channels, all said to be exploding, with AI translation used because they do not speak Chinese or Korean.
quote: We have seven other channels
falsify_match: Not applicable; a statement about the operation.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though it records the reach claimed at this date.

claim_text: A rebuke of New York for embracing its mayoral candidate, framed as a reprobate mind, alongside a recollection of the factories he saw shut down.
quote: the people try to embrace this this nutcase in in in uh New York
falsify_match: Not applicable; a judgment on a primary result that had just happened.
falsify_miss: Not applicable. Mamdani had won the Democratic primary four days before this recording.

claim_text: Buildings condemned and unenterable, and flights across America carrying only four or five people because people are too frightened to fly.
quote: there were only like four and five people in because people were so scared
falsify_match: American domestic air travel collapsing to near-empty flights.
falsify_miss: Load factors stay above eighty percent. This happened briefly in 2020, which is the reference point for what would count.

claim_text: Prayer against a two-state solution and for Judge Torres, with a kink in the hose that must come unkinked, and a great financial acceleration for the body of Christ when it does.
quote: Tell the hoes to come unckinked. It's time to double it
falsify_match: A favourable ruling followed by a large financial move.
falsify_miss: The ruling goes the other way with no move. He calls the 26 June Torres decision a disappointment the next day, which dates his reaction to the outcome.

claim_text: Prayer for peace over Jerusalem against a two-state solution, and protection over American Fourth of July gatherings, parades and firework shows.
quote: they will not touch the land in the name of Jesus
falsify_match: Not applicable; a petition.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: Prayer over the electric grid, water, Bank of America and the major banks against cyber attacks causing financial meltdown, and over cattle and poultry against plans he attributes to Bill Gates.
quote: Bank of America will not have major cyber attacks
falsify_match: Not applicable; a petition, though it names a specific bank.
falsify_miss: Not applicable. Naming Bank of America is the one detail that would make a later attack look pointed.

claim_text: He reports being taken to New York in the spirit and praying around its edges, with a plea over his own eyes to see only what he is meant to see.
quote: I plead the blood over my eyes
falsify_match: Not applicable; no content is given.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: Crowds walking the streets of New York in casual clothes rather than suits, no jeans and t-shirts being unusual in itself, and a white cargo van seen among them.
quote: I see a white van. It's a cargo van
falsify_match: A vehicle attack in New York using a white cargo van.
falsify_miss: No such attack. White cargo vans and casually dressed crowds are the ordinary state of a New York street, so nothing here departs from the baseline.

claim_text: Yankee Stadium seen again, lit up with lights.
quote: I see the New York Yankee Stadium again. I see it all lit up
falsify_match: An incident at Yankee Stadium during a night game.
falsify_miss: No incident. A lit stadium is what a night game looks like; no content is attached here.

claim_text: Many fires in California that are being deliberately started, and he begins counting them and reaches four.
quote: They're being started. I see fires in in certain area
falsify_match: Four significant Californian fires established as arson in one season.
falsify_miss: Fires occur with the usual mix of causes. Arson is already a confirmed cause in a share of Californian fires every year, so the count is the only distinguishing part.

claim_text: A great revival and a great shaking coming to Japan with great earthquakes, on the ring of fire, alongside a reference to the Sooners.
quote: A great earthquakes are coming to Japan
falsify_match: A major Japanese earthquake followed by unusual religious growth there.
falsify_miss: Japanese seismicity stays at its normal rate and nothing changes religiously. Base rate: Japan records several magnitude 6 or larger events a year.

claim_text: Earthquakes in China, all on the sea in one area, with the numbers 6.5 and 6.1 seen.
quote: I see the number 6.5. 6.1
falsify_match: Offshore Chinese earthquakes of magnitude 6.5 and 6.1.
falsify_miss: No such pair. Two magnitudes given together is unusually specific for this corpus; China averages roughly one magnitude 6 event a year, and offshore ones are rarer still.

claim_text: Prayer over Trump's hotels and apartment buildings in Las Vegas, Chicago and New York, with two in particular having something inside them, the glass blowing outward rather than in, and Trump seen at the top of a tall hotel-like building.
quote: it was coming from the from the inside out and it was glass
falsify_match: An internal explosion at a Trump-branded tower.
falsify_miss: No such incident. This telling identifies the two inside-out buildings as Trump properties, which the New York version does not.

claim_text: Revival called over Nigeria, Puerto Rico, Nicaragua, Iran, Canada, Brazil, Mexico and South Korea, with prayer over the nuclear power plants along the Mississippi and over boats in a park at Orlando.
quote: I saw about the nuclear power plants
falsify_match: An incident at a Mississippi river nuclear plant, or at boats in an Orlando park.
falsify_miss: Neither occurs. The Orlando boats are specific enough to be checkable, which is rare in the prayer sections.

claim_text: A plane leaving the central part of America for the Boston area with its dash going completely blank halfway there, and falling, which he assumes was a cyber attack while saying he does not know how one would reach the aircraft.
quote: its dash went completely blank and it fell
falsify_match: A crash on a route from the American midwest to Boston attributed to an electronics failure.
falsify_miss: No such crash. He raises himself the question of whether it is one specific flight or an example, which leaves the specificity open.

claim_text: A cyber attack on the vulnerable electric grid leaves New York completely dark, with generators and spotlights brought in to keep sections lit against looting, hospitals on dimmer emergency power, and hot weather outside.
quote: it was uh New York and it was completely dark
falsify_match: A prolonged New York blackout attributed to a cyber attack, in summer.
falsify_miss: No such blackout. New York has had major summer blackouts in 1977, 2003 and 2019 from equipment failures, so the scene is drawn from a known pattern.

claim_text: Tumbleweeds blowing down Wall Street and the lion carved on the side of the building he later identifies as the New York Stock Exchange, with a warning that if Jerusalem is divided America will be divided.
quote: I saw tumble weeds going down Wall Street
falsify_match: A prolonged closure of the exchange following a division of Jerusalem.
falsify_miss: No closure. This is the earliest telling of the lions on file, one day before the fuller version.

claim_text: In the New Madrid earthquake he sees over 1,800 dead from Texarkana to Tulsa, the large skyscraper-like building at the University of Oklahoma split down the middle and burning, houses on cinder blocks levelled and houses on foundations surviving, and thousands dead overall.
quote: I saw over 1,800 people die
falsify_match: A New Madrid earthquake with a death toll near 1,800 in that corridor and the named Oklahoma building destroyed.
falsify_miss: No such earthquake. The figure and the named building make this the most specific form of the New Madrid claim in the corpus.

claim_text: Three days after a division of the land is agreed upon, America is divided straight down the middle, with old cast iron bells and the Liberty Bell heard ringing when it happens.
quote: Three days after it's divided and it's agreed upon
falsify_match: A catastrophic American event within three days of a formal agreement dividing Jerusalem.
falsify_miss: No such event follows any agreement. The three day interval is the sharpest timing condition in the corpus, and it requires a formal division of Jerusalem to start the clock.

claim_text: He points to Kennedy saying Americans should wear a tracking device on the body or wrist and have a digital ID, and reads it as the mark of the beast system arriving faster than people realise, alongside the crypto for car and house loans word he says was given in February.
quote: he's talking about putting uh tracking devices on people's arms
falsify_match: A federal wearable or implanted identifier programme.
falsify_miss: No such programme. Kennedy's remark was about wearable health trackers, which he restates as tracking devices in arms.

claim_text: A factory shut down again with a contamination sign and caution tape across the doors, in cold weather with people in heavy coats and almost nobody outside, in either Chicago or New York.
quote: with that that that caution tape across the doors
falsify_match: A major food or industrial plant closed for contamination in one of those cities in winter, with streets emptied.
falsify_miss: No such closure. He cannot decide between the two cities, which halves the specificity.

claim_text: A black submarine surfaced and heading for Cuba along the east coast, which he identifies as Russian.
quote: it's headed towards Cuba and it's on the east coast
falsify_match: A Russian submarine transiting the American east coast to Cuba.
falsify_miss: No such transit. This happened in June 2024, a year before, and was tracked publicly the whole way.

claim_text: He repeats the submarine as surfaced, black and Russian, headed for Cuba.
quote: Yeah, it's Russian. It's a Russian submarine
falsify_match: As above.
falsify_miss: As above; this is the same passage repeated within the live stream.

claim_text: A submarine coming from Europe across the Atlantic, and rats being released on the ground in Europe, where he says the virus will first take hold rather than in America.
quote: It will first take hold in Europe
falsify_match: An epidemic beginning in Europe with a rodent vector.
falsify_miss: No such epidemic. Released rather than natural is the part that would distinguish this from an ordinary outbreak.

claim_text: The rats are on old cobblestone streets in old European villages rather than anywhere in America, which he offers as evidence the setting is Europe, and he ties it back to a lab vision from over a year earlier where they were practising on rats.
quote: I saw rats and I'm like why are we why am I sitting the rats
falsify_match: A laboratory origin established for a European rodent-borne outbreak.
falsify_miss: No such origin. The cobblestone detail fixes the setting as old Europe but names no country beyond the earlier France telling.

claim_text: Blue paper money with a blue design that people are afraid to touch in case it transmits the virus, identified in the room as the euro, which he says will be one of the first dominoes to fall, and the fear of cash speeds the new system in.
quote: This is going to introduce the the system faster being afraid to touch money
falsify_match: Cash handling restricted in Europe during an outbreak, accelerating a digital euro.
falsify_miss: Cash use continues. This happened at small scale during COVID, when some retailers refused notes, so a repeat would need to go further to count.
